procedure:
"""Read-only inventory of completed probability studies; no new fits or selection."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
OUT=Path(__file__).parent
ROOT=Path('/home/russell/wt/crypto-predictability-15-20261017')
BASE=OUT.parent
inputs={}
def read_csv(p):
    inputs[str(p)]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return pd.read_csv(p,dtype={'bin':str,'probability_bin':str})
def read_json(p):
    inputs[str(p)]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return json.loads(p.read_text())
protocol=read_json(OUT/'protocol.json')
pairs=[]
for batch,dirname,count in [('aligned','warmup20-20261018',57),('tuning','pocket-tuning-20261018',20)]:
    p=BASE/dirname
    d=read_csv(p/'all-cells.csv').rename(columns={'lead_minutes':'lead','probability_bin':'bin','markets':'n'})
    assert len(d)==count*100*2
    assert not d.duplicated(['method','asset','lead','bin','stage']).any()
    lock=read_json(p/'selection-lock.json')
    chosen={(c['method'],c['asset'],c['lead'],c['bin']) for c in lock['selected_cells']}
    inf=read_csv(p/'all-cell-inference.csv')
    if batch=='aligned':
        inf=inf.rename(columns={'delta_logloss_adjusted_p':'raw_day_adjusted_p','delta_logloss_week_p5700':'raw_week_adjusted_p'})
        inf=inf[['stage','method','asset','lead','bin','raw_day_adjusted_p','raw_week_adjusted_p']]
    else:
        inf=inf[inf.comparator=='raw'].rename(columns={'day_adjusted_p':'raw_day_adjusted_p','week_adjusted_p':'raw_week_adjusted_p'})
        inf=inf[['stage','method','asset','lead','bin','raw_day_adjusted_p','raw_week_adjusted_p','half1','half2']]
    d=d.merge(inf,on=['stage','method','asset','lead','bin'],validate='one_to_one')
    keys=['method','asset','lead','bin']
    fields=['n','days','mid','prediction','label','model_logloss','market_logloss','model_brier','market_brier','delta_logloss','delta_brier','delta_cal_logloss','delta_cal_brier','raw_day_adjusted_p','raw_week_adjusted_p']
    if batch=='tuning':fields+=['half1','half2']
    wide=d[d.stage=='warmup'][keys+fields].merge(d[d.stage=='validation'][keys+fields],on=keys,suffixes=('_warmup','_validation'),validate='one_to_one')
    wide['batch']=batch
    wide['model_id']=wide.method.map(lambda n:batch+'-'+str(n).zfill(2))
    wide['preselected']=[(r.method,r.asset,r.lead,r.bin) in chosen for r in wide.itertuples()]
    wide['adequate_sample']=(wide.n_warmup>=200)&(wide.n_validation>=200)&(wide.days_warmup>=20)&(wide.days_validation>=20)
    wide['two_period_score_support']=wide.adequate_sample
    for stage in ['warmup','validation']:
        wide['two_period_score_support'] &= (wide['delta_logloss_'+stage]<0)&(wide['delta_brier_'+stage]<=0)
    wide['beyond_calibration']=wide.two_period_score_support
    for stage in ['warmup','validation']:
        wide['beyond_calibration'] &= (wide['delta_cal_logloss_'+stage]<0)&(wide['delta_cal_brier_'+stage]<=0)
    # Full exploratory families remain5700 and2000, not reduced to the surviving catalog.
    wide['validation_full_scan_day_week_pass']=(wide.raw_day_adjusted_p_validation<.05)&(wide.raw_week_adjusted_p_validation<.05)&(wide.delta_logloss_validation<0)&(wide.delta_brier_validation<=0)
    pairs.append(wide)
pairs=pd.concat(pairs,ignore_index=True)
assert len(pairs)==7700
assert not pairs.duplicated(['model_id','asset','lead','bin']).any()
cells=[]
for key,g in pairs.groupby(['asset','lead','bin'],sort=True):
    r=g.iloc[0]
    for stage in ['warmup','validation']:
        for field in ['n','days','mid','label','market_logloss','market_brier']:
            assert np.max(np.abs(g[field+'_'+stage]-r[field+'_'+stage]))<1e-12,(key,stage,field)
    ids=lambda df:sorted(df.model_id.tolist())
    supported=g[g.two_period_score_support]
    gapw=float(r.label_warmup-r.mid_warmup);gapv=float(r.label_validation-r.mid_validation)
    material=bool(r.adequate_sample and gapw*gapv>0 and min(abs(gapw),abs(gapv))>=.01)
    original=g[g.preselected]
    if len(original[original.two_period_score_support]):status='Previously selected; some two-period score support'
    elif len(supported):status='Exploratory two-period score support'
    elif material:status='Persistent mean gap only'
    elif len(original):status='Previously selected; no two-period score support'
    else:status='No support under declared descriptive screen'
    row=dict(asset=key[0],lead=int(key[1]),bin=key[2],status=status,
      warmup_n=int(r.n_warmup),validation_n=int(r.n_validation),
      warmup_days=int(r.days_warmup),validation_days=int(r.days_validation),
      warmup_market=float(r.mid_warmup),warmup_realized=float(r.label_warmup),
      validation_market=float(r.mid_validation),validation_realized=float(r.label_validation),
      warmup_gap_pp=100*gapw,validation_gap_pp=100*gapv,material_gap=material,
      gap_direction='YES underpriced in both period means' if gapw>0 and gapv>0 else 'NO underpriced in both period means' if gapw<0 and gapv<0 else 'Mean gap changes sign',
      preselected_ids=ids(original),support_ids=ids(supported),calibration_support_ids=ids(g[g.beyond_calibration]),
      full_scan_pass_ids=ids(g[g.validation_full_scan_day_week_pass]))
    for model in ['aligned-24','aligned-02']:
        m=g[g.model_id==model].iloc[0]
        for stage in ['warmup','validation']:
            for field in ['delta_logloss','delta_brier','delta_cal_logloss']:
                row[model+'_'+stage+'_'+field]=float(m[field+'_'+stage])
    cells.append(row)
assert len(cells)==100
result=dict(protocol=protocol,input_hashes=inputs,scope=dict(cells=100,paired_model_cells=7700,original_stage_cell_rows=15400,aligned_methods=57,tuning_settings=20),
 counts=dict(statuses=pd.Series([c['status'] for c in cells]).value_counts().to_dict(),
   two_period_score_cells=sum(bool(c['support_ids']) for c in cells),
   beyond_calibration_cells=sum(bool(c['calibration_support_ids']) for c in cells),
   material_gap_cells=sum(c['material_gap'] for c in cells),
   full_scan_day_week_cells=sum(bool(c['full_scan_pass_ids']) for c in cells)),
 cells=cells)
assert not (OUT/'inventory.json').exists()
pairs.to_csv(OUT/'all-model-cell-pairs.csv',index=False)
flat=[{k:';'.join(v) if isinstance(v,list) else v for k,v in c.items()} for c in cells]
pd.DataFrame(flat).to_csv(OUT/'all-100-cells.csv',index=False)
(OUT/'inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result['counts'],indent=2))
for c in cells:
 if c['preselected_ids'] or c['material_gap']:
    print(c['asset'],c['lead'],c['bin'],'n',c['validation_n'],'gaps',round(c['warmup_gap_pp'],2),round(c['validation_gap_pp'],2),'support',len(c['support_ids']),'cal',len(c['calibration_support_ids']),'selected',c['preselected_ids'])
